_doc: make_catalogue.py's spec: everything in CATALOGUE.md that the CAD does not
know. Every dimension, capacity and model code comes from parts.csv through
cad.derive; this file holds the words around them and the links out.
makerworld: one URL per game (the family's listing), or per '<Game>/<Short
name>' for a cascade with a listing of its own. An empty string falls back
to makerworld_collection, the collection every listing is in; null says
the family is not on MakerWorld yet.
families: the order the games appear in, and each one's blurb.
printers: what parts.csv's `3D printer` column means for a reader.
dominion_guide: which cascade holds which expansion, by printer and
sleeving, carried over from `Cascade Sizes.docx` (v6.0) unchanged.
made_for: a reader's wording for a row's `Set/Extension`, keyed '<Game>/<Short name>', where parts.csv's is a working note.

profiles: per '<Game>/<Short name>', {"Un": <profileId>, "Sl": <profileId>} of that cascade's print profile on the family's MakerWorld model (the number after #profileId- in the profile's URL), or a full URL. A sleeving without one links the model page.
hidden: families kept out of the catalogue until they are published.

Dominion.title: Dominion
Dominion.games: Dominion and every expansion; any game with the same 59 x 91 mm card
Dominion.blurb: The original family, one cascade per expansion. Kingdom cards go ten to a sliding slot and the front pockets take the big piles (Copper, Curses, Estates). Some boxes merge two front pockets for player mats and every box takes a removable token holder.

FCM.title: Food Chain Magnate
FCM.games: Food Chain Magnate and The Ketchup Mechanism; any game with a 58 x 88 mm card
FCM.blurb: Sized for FCM's employee cards: shallow slots (six cards) for the many small piles, and the Milestones box is a separate cascade. The slot is the same width as Dominion's, so any 58-60 mm card fits.

Innovation.title: Innovation
Innovation.games: Innovation (Ultimate edition and the older ones); any game with a 63 x 88 mm card
Innovation.blurb: Ten or fifteen cards to a slot, one age per column. The Ultimate edition's six expansions split across several cascades in three different ways, and the Single Mini is a narrow box for one expansion that fits a 180 mm bed.

Compile.title: Compile
Compile.games: Compile: Main 1 and its expansions; any game with a 65 x 92 mm card
Compile.blurb: The widest slot in the system and the shallowest: seven cards per slot, one protocol per slot. Ships with a second box without label holders on its last plate.

MiniCards.title: Mini Cards (generic)
MiniCards.games: Any game with 41 x 63 mm cards (mini European)
MiniCards.blurb: No game at all: a shorter box (86 mm instead of 105) for mini cards, to show what the system does at that size. Blank lid and blank 12 mm labels; put your own game's name on with a marker or a label maker.

printers.Large: 325 x 320 mm bed (Bambu H2 series or similar)
printers.Mixed: 256 mm bed unsleeved; 325 x 320 mm bed sleeved
printers.Mini: 180 mm bed (Bambu A1 mini or similar)

made_for.Dominion/333 Card: A 324-size expansion in a narrower, deeper box for small printers
made_for.Dominion/202 Card (Mat): Half of a mat expansion, with the mat slot (pairs with a 244 Card)
made_for.Dominion/244 Card: Half of Adventures, Nocturne or Plunder on a 256 mm bed
made_for.Dominion/246 Card: Just the bulky Base Set cards
made_for.Dominion/300 Card: Half of the Base Set on a 256 mm bed
made_for.Innovation/3 Ages 5 Expansions: Ultimate edition across four boxes, three ages per box
made_for.Innovation/4 Ages 5 Expansions: Ultimate edition across three boxes, four ages per box
made_for.Innovation/3 Later Ages 5 Expansions: Ultimate edition across four boxes, ages 2-10 only (ten cards per slot)
made_for.Innovation/4 Later Ages 5 Expansions: Ultimate edition across three boxes, ages 2-10 only (ten cards per slot)
made_for.Innovation/Three Expansions: Ultimate edition in two boxes that lie flat in the game box
made_for.Innovation/Single Set: The base set or one expansion
made_for.Innovation/Single Mini: One expansion on a 180 mm bed; two boxes per project, used as a pair
